title: i wonder if we all go at the same time?
content: for those in mall world, do you think it’s possible that the large amounts of people/employees we see in our dreams are just each other? i don’t want to discredit the fact that most dreams are unlinked, but seeing as we’re experiencing a phenomena that effects us all— do you think they could be connected? i’ve seen posts describing the exact cafe i work at in my dreams and it makes me feel so uneasy. we are all experiencing the same places, situations, etc. maybe you’ve seen me behind the counter and don’t even know it! just a weird thought.
